reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 rate of $2,101 per seat. I also replied to Anselm in their direct message to say it's ready for them to review and send. Nothing has been sent yet.

- **Approval:** Anselm is the CFO, so their approval in this direct message is enough to share the rate with Hollis. Hollis is at pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway didn't need to approve it.
- **Where the figure came from:** I used $2,101 exactly as Anselm gave it. I couldn't check it against any record Anselm can see: there are no Thornbury files on the share, and GBrain has no notes on Thornbury. Anselm said it was "as Marcus gave it", but Marcus's direct messages with me aren't something Anselm can see, so I didn't use them to check.
